    HOW TO PLAY

    A silent signal wakes up old space machines. Follow it from Earth to the Moon to Mars, dig up what was left behind, and learn the real story of the missions. The story is imagined; the Mission Files you unlock are real facts labeled FACT.

    YOUR GOAL

    1 · THE SIGNAL (Earth). Tune the incoming signal: slide FREQ until the green spike grows, then lower NOISE FILTER to clean the trace. When it says SIGNAL LOCKED, press DECODE. It drifts, so re-tune if you lose it.
    2 · THE SLEEPING MACHINE (Moon). Reach Surveyor 3. Dig up a battery cell and a wire loom, pick them up, then use the lander and connect the circuit: sunlight → storage → transmitter (solar panel → battery → radio). It is dark here, so use your lamp.
    3 · THE RED SILENCE (Mars). Dig up both signal traces, walk to the Phoenix lander, then compare the earlier and later images with the slider and tap all 3 differences.
    4 · WHAT REMAINS (Mars). One last walk to Phoenix across spikes, gaps and chemical (Cl) storms. Listen to the final message. There is no oxygen drain on this level.

    CONTROLS · KEYBOARD

    A / D or ← / →Move left / right W, ↑ or SpaceJump (don't over-jump!) X or QDig E or EnterUse / pick up / talk FLamp on / off (only needed in the dark) HSwitch on a Cl shield 1 – 5Use hotbar slots I · G · M · EscInventory · Mission Files · Mute · Pause

    CONTROLS · TOUCH

    Use the D-pad to move, JUMP to jump, DIG to dig and ACT to use or pick up. Tap the hotbar slots to use items. Hold your phone sideways for the best view. You can drag the buttons to new places from Pause → MOVE BUTTONS.

    STAYING ALIVE

    • You have 3 hearts. Lose them all and you restart the level you are on from its beginning.
    • O₂ and PWR bars drain on the Moon and on Mars (level 3), about 2 minutes in total. Press E at a pod to refill both (each pod works once). At 0 oxygen you lose hearts. The lamp also uses power.
    • Spikes hurt. Mind the pits and the edge of space: jumping too high or falling in costs a heart.
    • Mounds hide buried things. Dig where you see a glint: cyan = item or clue, then press E to collect. Amber = a mine, so don't dig there!
    • Meteors (Moon): when the alarm sounds and a red circle appears, get out of it before the rock lands.
    • Chemical storms (level 4): cross only while the storm is clear, or collect a Cl shield cell (E) and press H for 8 seconds of protection.
    • You respawn at your last safe spot after losing a heart.

    GOOD TO KNOW

    • A timer runs while you play. Finish levels to appear on the leaderboard.
    • Log in to save progress across devices; as a guest, progress is saved on this device only.
    • Open this guide again any time from the title screen or the Pause menu.
